content.title: 20 Restaurant Chains Open on Easter Sunday 2026
content.text: 24 Restaurant Chains Open on Easter Sunday (and a Bunch That Are Closed) Easter Sunday might be a time for church, egg hunts, and awkward family photos, but it doesn’t mean the whole country shuts down. While some restaurant chains close up to give their staff a well-earned break, plenty of spots will stay open. So in case you’re skipping the ham this year, here are the restaurant chains that are open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, plus the ones that are closed. Applebee’s Brett_Hondow/istockphoto Most Applebee’s locations will be open on Easter Sunday. Hours can vary, though, since the chain is franchise-operated, so it’s best to check with your local restaurant. Buffalo Wild Wings SweetBabeeJay/istockphoto Those craving wings after the egg hunt are in luck, as the chain plans to stay open on Easter, with most locations following regular Sunday hours. Still, a quick call ahead is recommended. Benihana ©TripAdvisor Benihana is typically open on Easter Sunday if you’re planning a hibachi-style meal, but hours can vary by location, so it’s best to check with your local restaurant before making plans. Burger King Jonathan Weiss / shutterstock You can have it your way on Easter Sunday. Most Burger King locations are open, though some may shorten hours, so it’s smart to check locally. Cheesecake Factory Christian Petersen/Getty Images Yes, they’re open — and yes, you can still end your Easter with a slab of Oreo Dream Extreme. Just keep in mind that some locations might tweak hours or limit reservations. Chili’s sanfel/istockphoto Chili’s Grill & Bar is expected to be open on Easter Sunday if you’re craving a sit-down meal, but hours can vary by location, so it’s best to check with your nearest restaurant before heading out. Denny’s sanfel/istockphoto Denny’s will remain open 24/7 as usual, with no changes for the holiday. Domino’s Pizza RiverNorthPhotography/istockphoto Most locations will be open for delivery and carryout on Easter, but hours can vary — check your local store before placing that order. Cracker Barrel sanfel/istockphoto Cracker Barrel will be open from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. on Easter Sunday, serving the usual comfort food for dine-in, takeout, or delivery. Dunkin’ Tim Gray/istockphoto Many Dunkin’ locations will be open, though some may reduce hours for the holiday. It’s a good idea to confirm with your local shop. Golden Corral jetcityimage/istockphoto Golden Corral will be open on Easter Sunday, following their standard hours at most locations. IHOP Wolterk/istockphoto IHOP will stay open nationwide, operating with either 24/7 or regular Sunday hours, depending on the branch. Jimmy John’s May A. / Yelp Jimmy John’s will be open on Easter Sunday, so you can still grab a sandwich — but it’s a good idea to check with your local store to confirm hours. KFC tupungato/istockphoto KFC will likely be open on Easter Sunday for your fried chicken fix, but since hours can vary, it’s best to check with your local restaurant before you go. McDonald’s jetcityimage/istockphoto Most McDonald’s restaurants will be open on Easter, but hours vary widely depending on the location. Olive Garden Brett_Hondow/istockphoto Olive Garden will be open on Easter Sunday, following their usual Sunday hours. The chain typically only closes on Thanksgiving and Christmas. Red Lobster jetcityimage/istockphoto Red Lobster plans to open most locations for Easter, though some may limit service to takeout and delivery only. Sonic Drive-In Wolterk/istockphoto Sonic will be open and operating under normal Sunday hours, with drive-in and carhop service as usual. Starbucks jetcityimage/istockphoto Starbucks locations will be open, but many will have reduced or adjusted hours. Checking the store locator is recommended. Subway TennesseePhotographer / istockphoto Most Subway restaurants will be open on Easter, though hours depend on the individual franchise. Calling ahead is best. Taco Bell Jonathan Weiss / shutterstock Taco Bell is expected to open most locations with regular Sunday hours, but there may be some local variations. Texas Roadhouse jetcityimage/istockphoto Texas Roadhouse will be open on Easter Sunday, though hours can vary depending on the location. Waffle House jetcityimage/istockphoto Waffle House remains open 24/7 every day of the year, including Easter Sunday. Wendy’s jetcityimage/istockphoto Most Wendy’s locations will be open on Easter, but store hours can differ. A quick local check is a good idea. CBS Mornings / Yelp Cava — Cava will be closed at all locations for Easter, treating it as a major holiday. Chick-fil-A — Chick-fil-A is always closed on Sundays, and Easter is no exception. Chipotle — All Chipotle locations will be closed on Easter Sunday as part of their standard holiday schedule. Firehouse Subs — Firehouse Subs will be closed for Easter to give employees the day off. Panera Bread — Most, if not all, Panera Bread cafés will be closed on Easter Sunday. A few franchise locations might open, but it’s not common. Raising Cane’s — Raising Cane’s will be closed at all locations in observance of the holiday.
